Pretupid Client 0.1.6 runs on fifteen Minecraft versions, from 1.21.2 to 26.3, and brings a standalone Meme Editor with camera angles, a much bigger Cinematic Studio with frame rendering, new waypoint markers and a cinematic main menu. The Pretupid Launcher installs the right build for your instance. Playing with another launcher? Download the jar that matches your Minecraft version and drop it into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API.

## What's new

### More Minecraft versions
- **1.21.2 to 1.21.8 added:** Pretupid Client now runs on 1.21.2, 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.
- **Motion Blur** needs Minecraft 1.21.6 or newer and is hidden on older versions.

### Meme Editor
- **Press F7:** a screenshot goes straight into the new Meme Editor.
- **Layouts:** top and bottom text, caption or poster, with empty text fields for your own lines.
- **Camera angles:** retake the picture as a face close-up, worm's eye, bird's eye, Dutch angle, fisheye, side profile or over the shoulder. Your text stays.
- **Screenie Studio (F4)** keeps filters and free text for normal screenshots.

### Cinematic Studio
- **Templates:** orbit around you, fly-by, crane up, dolly zoom and push in, built around where you stand.
- **Easing per keyframe:** smooth, linear, ease in, ease out or hold.
- **Speed and Look at me:** play shots from 0.25× to 4×, or keep the camera aimed at you while it moves.
- **Render:** turn a shot into PNG frames at 20 to 60 fps and up to three times your window size in `screenshots/pretupid-cinematic`.
- **Cleaner editor:** a bigger timeline, play and keyframe buttons, Duplicate, and keyboard control (Space, arrow keys, Home, End, Delete).
- **Fixed:** your hand no longer shows up in shots.

### Waypoints
- **New markers:** pins with a light beam, the full label with distance and height difference when you look at them, and a pointer at the screen edge for waypoints behind you.

### Main menu and cosmetics
- **Cinematic main menu:** cinema bars, drifting light and buttons that slide in, also on the first menu after starting the game. Turn it off in Settings.
- **Sharper cosmetics:** hats, back items and pets have twice the texture detail with shading and outlines, and pets float at shoulder height.

### Fixes
- **Edit HUD** no longer sticks out of the menu on small windows.
- **Screenies at window size** no longer include the HUD.

## Downloads
- **Client mod:** one jar per Minecraft version, for example `pretupid-client-0.1.6+mc26.3.jar` or `pretupid-client-0.1.6+mc1.21.4.jar`
- **Source:** the source code archives below

The launcher updates Pretupid Client to 0.1.6 on its own, and the client offers the update in-game as well.
